{{- /* layouts/_partials/scripts-body-end/search-data.html Site search / explorer / graph data (Base). Book-style: build assets/search-index.json once per language via resources.ExecuteAsTemplate → Minify → Fingerprint, then fetch it on the client. Pages only embed a short bootstrap (not the full index). Output contract (after fetch): window.__MDF_SEARCH__ = { baseURLPath, pages[], content? } Legacy aliases: __FOUNDRY_PAGES__, __FOUNDRY_CONTENT_INDEX__, __FOUNDRY_BASE_URL_PATH__ window.__MDF_SEARCH_READY__ — Promise that resolves to the payload window.__MDF_whenSearchReady__(cb, errCb) — helper for capability scripts */ -}} {{- $searchEnabled := false -}} {{- with .Site.Params.search -}} {{- if .enable -}}{{- $searchEnabled = true -}}{{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- $needsData := or $searchEnabled .Site.Params.explorer .Site.Params.graph -}} {{- if $needsData -}} {{- $lang := "en" -}} {{- with .Language -}} {{- with .Lang -}}{{- $lang = . -}}{{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- $indexName := printf "%s.search-index.json" $lang -}} {{- $index := resources.Get "search-index.json" | resources.ExecuteAsTemplate $indexName . | resources.Minify | resources.Fingerprint -}} {{- end -}}
